title: Subgroup transfer factors the index action on group cohomology
statement: Let k be a commutative ring, G a group with a finite-type structure, A a k-linear G-representation, H a subgroup equipped with a finite-type structure, and n a natural number. Use the common universe required by groupCohomology. There exist k-linear maps R : Hⁿ(G,A) → Hⁿ(H,Res_H A) and C : Hⁿ(H,Res_H A) → Hⁿ(G,A) such that C(R(x)) = [G:H] • x for every x, where • is repeated addition. No normality of H or finiteness of A is assumed.
lean_statement: ∀ {k G : Type _} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Fintype G] (A : Rep k G) (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype H] (n : ℕ), ∃ R : groupCohomology A n →ₗ[k] groupCohomology (Rep.res H.subtype A) n, ∃ C : groupCohomology (Rep.res H.subtype A) n →ₗ[k] groupCohomology A n, ∀ x : groupCohomology A n, C (R x) = H.index • x
